name: Fragment — Weather Report, Wrong City
author: Unknown / Weather Broadcast
description: A weather broadcast received on standard Meridian 88 frequencies that describes weather conditions for a city called "Meridian 89." The weather patterns described are familiar but inverted — where Meridian 88 had rain, 89 had sun. Where 88 was cold, 89 was warm. The broadcast lasted 47 seconds and has not repeated.
story_hooks: Why are the weather patterns exactly inverted?
